done_when: The review instructions block (P0/P1) only on a defect that would ship, a security, data-loss or accessibility gap, an unmet Done-when item, or a missing test for a Done-when item's own behaviour; extra edge-case tests, platform or hardening suggestions beyond what the item promises are P2 and never block or start a round. Close's output lists those non-blocking findings under a separate plain heading. The rules against dropping validation, security, data-loss protection or accessibility stay.
why: Most extra review rounds come from findings that ask for more edge-case tests or generic hardening beyond what the item promises, reported as blocking, so every change pays several rounds for wishlists
